summary.en: Ethiopian military drone strikes have crossed into Sudan, prompting Sudan to file formal complaints at the UN and the AU. The WHO warns that the health system in northern Ethiopia is near collapse as attacks on civilians continue, including an RPG strike near a school in Moyale that killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers. Kenya has begun registering over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees fleeing the Moyale clashes. There were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Etiopiske militære droneangrep har krysset inn i Sudan, noe som har fått Sudan til å sende formelle klager til FN og AU. WHO advarer om at helsesystemet i Nord-Etiopia er nær kollaps mens angrep på sivile fortsetter, inkludert et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale som drepte 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende. Kenya har begynt å registrere over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger som flykter fra sammenstøtene i Moyale. Det var 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
